name: browser/find-download
title: Find the download page
summary: Find the official download or documentation link for a program: the maker's site first, check the version and date.
when: Use when the user wants the official download or documentation link for a program.
steps: Write the program's exact name and its maker before searching for anything.
Call web_search with query set to the program name plus official download and max_results 6.
Pick the maker's own domain from the results and call browse_page with url set to it to see its download and docs links.
Call fetch_page with url set to the chosen link and read the version number, release date and supported systems.
Call fetch_pages with urls set to two maker pages when the first is unclear, and keep the newer version.
If no maker page is found, say so and give nothing from mirror, ad or download-portal sites; mark the link not found.
Answer with the official URL, version, date and system, cite it as [1], and say what the page did not confirm.
next: The final answer must give the official URL with its version, date and supported system, cite it as [1] with the URL, and say what the page did not confirm.
